note: Seven arms over the scope: a tracked source file in and a gitignored one out; .git, the store and the backup out by RULE rather than by path shape, with the fixture deliberately not gitignoring them so the rule is what excludes them; the walk not descending into what it ignores, proved semantically by a nested .gitignore that is decisive to a walk that descends and unreachable to one that prunes; the sync corpus unchanged; one ignore statement answering both questions; the ancestry and no-git conditions that the change of instrument would otherwise have dropped. Every probe is put to real git check-ignore with core.excludesFile=/dev/null, so the answer is not a property of the machine.
